title: Rome: you cannot prove from Scripture that Scripture alone is enough
source_text: XLIX. Superest ut unum adhuc Argumentum solvamus. Nam credere nos profitemur, & studiose asserimus Scripturam sacram continere omnia quae sunt ad fidem & salutem necessaria, & nullum esse Dei verbum non scriptum. At, inquiunt, hoc ipsum ex Scriptura probari non potest. Etenim istud non convincunt Scripturae loca quae in hanc rem proferuntur, & argumenta ex iis deducta facile solvi possunt. Respondeo veritatem quam hic tuemur posse ex ipsa Scriptura solide probari, & thesibus praecedentibus ex Scripturis eruta & vindicata fuisse argumenta quibus infirmatur traditionis non scriptae authoritas, & asseritur Scripturae perfectio & sufficientia, & alia plurima proferri a Theologis nostris, & ab adversariorum exceptionibus vindicari.
pass_a_gloss: It remains that we solve one argument still. For we profess to believe, and studiously assert, that sacred Scripture contains all things that are necessary to faith and salvation, and that there is no unwritten word of God. But, they say, this very thing cannot be proved from Scripture. For the places of Scripture that are brought forward for this matter do not convince it, and the arguments deduced from them can easily be solved. I answer that the truth which we defend here can be solidly proved from Scripture itself, and that by the preceding theses arguments have been drawn out from the Scriptures and vindicated by which the authority of unwritten tradition is weakened, and the perfection and sufficiency of Scripture is asserted, and that very many others are brought forward by our Theologians and vindicated from the adversaries exceptions.
pass_b_english: Last objection: you claim Scripture holds all needful to faith and salvation — and no unwritten word of God.
Rome: that claim itself cannot be proved from Scripture; the usual texts are answerable.
Answer: the thesis is solidly from Scripture; earlier theses already undercut unwritten tradition and assert Scripture perfection.
Our theologians bring still more proofs and clear the exceptions.
